title: Support Ticket Classifier
one_liner: A FastAPI endpoint that turns a raw support ticket into validated JSON (tags, priority, next action) through a provider-agnostic LLM door, with an eval script that scores it.

steps.text: Eight labelled sample tickets; one click classifies
A billing ticket: priority, tags and a suggested action, as JSON
Technical and urgent: a blank dashboard after login
The raw JSON the inbox would route on
The badge says which provider and model answered
Or paste your own ticket and press Classify
